frequency_question: How often does the council approve disputed financial service tax clarifications upon initial or near-term review?
membership_rule: Includes formal agenda items or rulings by the national tax council specifically addressing taxation of financial, banking, or NBFC intermediation services since the introduction of the unified indirect tax regime. Excludes general rate changes affecting all goods equally.
